# Cotton Valle

> Cotton Valle provides custom cotton, canvas and jute bags for retail, promotional, gifting and packaging projects. Product specifications, minimum order quantities and timelines depend on the submitted design and order requirements.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://www.cottonvalle.com/): Company and product overview
- [Products](https://www.cottonvalle.com/products): Available bag categories
- [Custom cotton tote bags](https://www.cottonvalle.com/custom-cotton-tote-bags): Lightweight cotton tote options
- [Canvas tote bags](https://www.cottonvalle.com/canvas-tote-bags): Structured canvas tote options
- [Organic cotton bags](https://www.cottonvalle.com/organic-cotton-bags): Organic cotton material options
- [Cotton drawstring bags](https://www.cottonvalle.com/cotton-drawstring-bags): Drawstring bag options
- [Jute bags](https://www.cottonvalle.com/jute-bags): Natural jute bag options
- [Canvas zip pouches](https://www.cottonvalle.com/canvas-zip-pouches): Zipper pouch options

## Buyer resources
- [Fabric weight guide](https://www.cottonvalle.com/fabric-weight-guide): Cotton and canvas weight selection
- [Printing methods](https://www.cottonvalle.com/printing-methods): Screen printing, DTG, heat transfer, embroidery and labels
- [Custom options](https://www.cottonvalle.com/custom-options): Size, handles, branding and packing choices
- [Factory workflow](https://www.cottonvalle.com/factory-workflow): Project and approval workflow
- [FAQ](https://www.cottonvalle.com/faq): Ordering, customization, samples and shipping
- [Request a quote](https://www.cottonvalle.com/quote): Submit project requirements

## Quotation context
For a useful quotation, provide bag style, dimensions, target quantity, fabric preference, artwork, branding method, packing requirements, destination and required delivery date. Cotton Valle does not publish a single universal MOQ or lead time because these vary by design.
